div.head: Rect 6.2, 6.3, 6.4
div.ab: On manegum lan|dum gebyreð deopre swanriht. gyme eac swan þæt he æfter sticunge his slyhtswyn wel behweor|fe sæncge . ðonne bið he ful wel gewyrces wyr|ðe . eac he sceal beon swa ic ær be beocere cwæð. oftræde to gehwilcon weorce. 7 gehorsad to hlafordes neode . ðeowswan . 7 ðeow beoce|re . æfter forðsiðe be anre lage wyrðe .

On many estates deeper duties are owed from the swineherd. Also, the duty of the swineherd is that he sends slaughtered pigs well-prepared after [their] slaughter, then he will be full-well worth his perquisites. Also, just as I said before concerning the beekeeper, he must be ready all the while to work, and horsed for the lord’s needs. The bound swineherd and the bound beekeeper, after departing, are worthy of the same law.

[6.2] gyme eac swan, þæt he æfter sticunge his slyhtswyn wel behweorfe [7] sæncge; ðonne bið he ful wel gewyrces wyrðe. [6.3] Eac he sceal beon – swa ic ær be beocere cwæð – oftræde to gehwilcon weorce 7 gehorsad to hlafordes neode. [6.4] Ðeow swan 7 ðeow beocere æfter forðsiðe be anre lage wyrðe.
